hypothesis: Independently recognized shared utterances can provide lexical candidates where frozen waveform anchors refused. No supplied text is recognition evidence.
stage: lexical availability scout; timing acceptance only if lexical prerequisites pass
inputs: Complete frozen nine mono16k Float32 WAVs from the existing synchronization manifest; no new decoding, resampling or source edits
recognition: Registered Parakeet TDT0.6b-v2, native speech.transcribe, default source-windows-20s-context4s-guard1s-v2, one complete20s window, no context or prompt

lexicalGate.normalization: existing core foldWord only; no synonyms, numeral expansion or guessed fragments
lexicalGate.ambiguity: Each five-word phrase must occur exactly once in each source's complete selected transcript set; retain repeated competitors rather than choose one
lexicalGate.continuity: Never join words across selected windows; compare all retained windows across each source pair, including different clock selections
lexicalGate.interpretation: Provider text correspondence only. Even a lexical gate pass is not synchronization. Return candidates and refusal reasons, never an inferred clock.

timingPrerequisites.recipe: Accepted10B independent source alignment on each recognized phrase, unambiguous all-optimal correspondence and complete physical admission; supplied paths alone insufficient
timingPrerequisites.clock: Exact original source selection origin plus retained native rational frame/sample clock; preserve competing estimates and every endpoint residual
timingPrerequisites.knownDelay: Independently planted125ms delay on retained speech with exact16k sample membership; also different absolute source origins to expose local-clock substitution
timingPrerequisites.resolution: 80ms native CTC cells bound this conditional estimate; never claim2ms acoustic precision or calibrated confidence
timingPrerequisites.refusal: Any insufficient, ambiguous, physically unsupported, inconsistent or drifted mapping refuses one constant offset. No trimming an outlier, automatic segmenting or retime.

budget.timingInference: Not authorized by this scout runner; a separate frozen follow-up must implement and pass all timing controls before any real timing inference
budget.replay: Reuse complete captured raw recognition, hash-bound requests and input manifest; no repeated inference for docs or replay

retention: Freeze this protocol hash and complete input/native/model request identities before first real inference. Preserve waveform protocol and all failed gates unchanged.
productBoundary: Research only. No relationship declaration, camera choice, retime, edit, provider promotion or speaker identity. A refused lexical prerequisite reslices the next research step.
